sourceRefs.locator: ARTEM 4511, Archives nationales AE II 6 (K 2 no. 3). Header, regest and ll. 3–4, naming the king’s parents Dagobert and Nanthild as buried in the basilica. Clichy, 22 June 654.
pp. 353–355, particularly p. 354. Royal confirmation of Landry’s privilege, sung praise on the model of Agaune, signatories and the king’s parents.

labels.de: Chlodwig II. verfügt den Lobgesang für seine Eltern
labels.en: Clovis II provides for sung praise in memory of his parents

note.de: In der Urkunde aus Clichy für Saint-Denis werden der Schutz des kirchlichen Besitzes und der fortdauernde Lobgesang miteinander verknüpft.
note.en: The act from Clichy for Saint-Denis connects the protection of the community’s possessions with an unbroken succession of sung praises.
